failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: Cost dashboard's CONTEXT EFFICIENCY test asserts on loop.context_efficiency event data, but the test's cost-entries fixture (last 30 days) is empty, so the dashboard reports 'No cost entries' instead of rendering the expected section
failures.fix: Seed a cost entry (or mock costs.json) with a recent timestamp in the sw-cost-test.sh fixture setup before invoking the dashboard so the 30-day lookback window is non-empty

failures.root_cause: Pipeline E2E tests fail because plan.md/review.md artifacts aren't written to .claude/pipeline-artifacts/, cascading into dependent tests (full E2E, resume, cleanup) and low-complexity intelligence skip test
failures.fix: Verify the plan/review stage functions write artifacts to the expected .claude/pipeline-artifacts/ path in sw-pipeline.sh before the E2E test checks for them

failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: Two suites (sw-e2e-integration-test, sw-intent-analysis-test) exited 1 amid an otherwise passing 162-suite run; the reveal-summary line miscounts and reports only 1/3 pass instead of reflecting the true near-total pass count, masking the real signal which is just these two failing suites
failures.fix: Investigate sw-e2e-integration-test and sw-intent-analysis-test failures directly (likely missing API keys/env or a flaky external dependency given e2e-integration's name), and separately fix the pass-count aggregation in sw-test-all.sh's summary reveal logic

failures.root_cause: The pipeline log shows all captured test suites passing (PASS counts with 0 FAIL each), but the overall stage reported Failed: 1, indicating a failure occurred in a suite outside the shown log excerpt (log was truncated to last 200 lines) or a test runner exit code mismatch not reflected in the visible PASS/FAIL tallies.
failures.fix: Re-run the full test suite output (not just the tail) to identify which specific suite reported the 1 failure, since none of the suites shown in this excerpt failed.
